rationale: The base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5, which dropped protocol v2 support (now v3-only). The Yard Cam (CAM-S1) was still on firmware 1.8 speaking protocol v2, producing E-305 "protocol v2 not supported" and stopping event uploads while live view continued. The OTA upgrade to 2.1 (protocol v3) completed successfully and motion clips resumed uploading, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm Yard Cam firmware is now 2.1 and status is online with events uploading.
Verify no E-305 errors remain in base station logs.
Ask customer to test motion detection and confirm clips appear in app.
Close case with root cause PERIPHERAL_FW_OUTDATED and resolution OTA update to 2.1.
output.customer_reply: Your Yard Cam is now updated and motion clips are uploading again. The issue was a firmware mismatch after the base station update. Everything is resolved. If you notice any further problems, please let us know. Thank you for your patience!

args.query: PERIPHERAL_FW_OUTDATED E-305 OTA upgrade camera firmware fix procedure

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.
